# IMDA - Infocomm Media Development Authority

> > Singapore's Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) - driving digital inclusion through subsidized broadband and device programs for low-income households and students.

IMDA operates critical digital access initiatives including the NEU PC Plus Programme, Home Access Programme, and DigitalAccess@Home to bridge the digital divide. The agency provides e-services for program applications, eligibility verification, and showcases innovation through its PIXEL hub.

## Key Topics

- Digital Access Programme
- NEU PC Plus Programme
- Home Access Programme
- DigitalAccess@Home
- ScamShield
- CorpPass authentication
- Broadband subsidy
- Laptop subsidy
- Low-income assistance
- Digital inclusion
- HDB residents eligibility
- Mobile Access
- NORS (National Opt-out Registry System)
- Student programs
- PIXEL innovation hub

## Digital Access Programs & Services

- [Digital Access System](https://eservice.imda.gov.sg/das/homepage): Digital Access System for broadband and laptop subsidies for low-income
- [NEU PC Plus Programme](https://eservice.imda.gov.sg/neupc/homepage.action): NEU PC Plus Programme management system for digital access applications

## Innovation & Success Stories

- [PIXEL Success Stories](https://pixel.imda.gov.sg/success-stories/): Pixel innovation hub startup success stories with Shell and P&G partners
